programme_detail_official.description: The University of Auckland International Student Excellence Scholarship provides a tuition fees credit of up to 25% of one year of tuition fees to new international master's students at Waipapa Taumata Rau. Applicants do not apply directly: those holding a conditional or unconditional programme offer for Semester One or Quarter Two 2027 by 20 October 2026 are invited on 21 October 2026 to complete a supplementary application form, due 4 November 2026. Eligibility requires an Admissions GPE of at least 7.0 and exclusion of prior study at the University, prior tertiary study in New Zealand (other than exchange), distance enrolment, and most Graduate School of Management programmes. Selection is by a committee recommendation to the Vice-Chancellor on academic merit and personal statement, and recipients must complete at least two consecutive semesters or repay the value.

research_notes.logo: Scanned the official scholarship page and the official international-students scholarships page markup for logo assets. The site header renders the University wordmark from the shared icon sprite `/etc.clientlibs/uoa-digital/clientlibs/resources/img/sprite.svg#logo-small-new`, which is a fragment reference and not a standalone image, and `/etc.clientlibs/uoa-digital/clientlibs/resources/svg/logo.svg` returned HTTP 404. The page head declares `<link rel="icon" type="image/svg+xml" href="/etc.clientlibs/uoa-digital/clientlibs/resources/svg/favicon.svg"/>`, and that asset was probed and returned the full SVG source of the University's crest filled with #0C0C48 (dark navy) on a transparent background, so it is visible on a light card. Used as the official logo; it is the awarding body's own mark on its own domain.

new_scholarship.description: The University of Auckland Doctoral Scholarship is a competitive scheme run in four awarding rounds each year for high-achieving candidates applying for admission to an approved doctoral programme at Waipapa Taumata Rau. In 2026 it provides a tax-free stipend of $35,468 per annum with an annual CPI adjustment for up to 42 months full-time equivalent, compulsory tuition fees and the Student Services Fee for the same period, and the single student health insurance charge where applicable. No separate scholarship application is needed — the candidate confirms in the doctoral programme application that they wish to be considered, and must not enrol before the outcome is advised. The 2027 dates table gives the next apply-by date as 1 November 2026.

research_notes.logo: Scanned the official page markup for logo assets. The site header wordmark https://www.otago.ac.nz/__data/assets/file/0034/568366/UoO_Logo_RGB_Horz_Gold-REV.svg was probed and REJECTED: its stylesheet is `.st0{fill:#FFFFFF;}` with only `.st1{fill:#F4B142;}` for the tohu, so the wordmark is white-on-transparent and would be invisible on a light card. The University's Wordmark (logo) files on its Brand Guide page are restricted to University staff login, and no dark or coloured wordmark variant is published publicly. The footer emblem https://www.otago.ac.nz/__data/assets/image/0028/568108/1869-emblem.png was probed instead: it returned "Image fetched successfully" (HTTP 200, image content type) and shows the University's gold coat-of-arms emblem with 1869 — the awarding body's own mark, on its own domain, in a colour rather than white. That emblem is used for this record and for the two other University of Otago records in this shard.

programme_detail_official.description: The University of Otago International Academic Excellence Scholarships are for high achieving international students who have studied overseas and are commencing a full-time Bachelor degree at Otago. The official page gives a value of approximately NZD $35,000, made up of a first-year residential college accommodation scholarship and tuition scholarships in the second and third years. It is a competitive selection award with no public application route: applicants are invited to apply in eVision only after accepting a previous scholarship offer such as the Vice-Chancellor's Scholarship for International Students or a Global Scholarship, and must complete the scholarship application questions as requested. The award sits within the University's standard Undergraduate Entrance Scholarship terms and conditions except where superseded.
programme_detail_official.program_type: Undergraduate competitive selection scholarship (accommodation and tuition fees)
programme_detail_official.coverage: Residential college accommodation fees in year one and tuition fees in years two and three

application_readiness_checklist: Apply for admission as an international undergraduate and hold an offer of a place at Otago
Apply for an earlier Otago international scholarship such as the Vice-Chancellor's Scholarship for International Students or a Global Scholarship, since acceptance of one triggers this invitation
Watch eVision for the invitation to apply for the International Academic Excellence Scholarship
Complete all scholarship application questions in eVision within the window given in the invitation
Plan for the first-year component to be residential college accommodation rather than a tuition waiver, and budget tuition fees separately for year one
common_rejection_risks: Not holding a previous Otago international scholarship offer, so no invitation is issued
Missing the eVision invitation window and not completing the scholarship application questions
Weaker academic record than other invited applicants, since this is a competitive selection scholarship
Assuming the award is a full tuition waiver in year one when the first-year component is accommodation
estimated_uncovered_costs: First-year tuition fees, since the year-one component is an accommodation scholarship
Student Services Fee if not included in the accommodation or tuition scholarship
Living costs beyond residential college accommodation fees
Travel, visa and insurance costs
Costs beyond the third year of the degree
document_audit: eVision scholarship application questions completed and submitted in response to the invitation
Evidence of the earlier scholarship offer acceptance that triggered the invitation
Evidence of the study completed overseas referenced in the scholarship application
